title: AAC Configuration Bootstrap 1
description: Defines the canonical AAC Configuration Bootstrap schema and its serialized data contract.

ConfigurationBootstrap.description: Configuration bootstrap data used to initialize configuration profiles and providers.

DefaultConfigurationProfile.description: Specifies the default configuration profile for this configuration bootstrap.

WorkspaceConfigurationProfiles.description: Specifies the workspace configuration profiles for this configuration bootstrap.

MandatoryConfigurationScopeDefinitionIds.description: Lists stable identifiers associated with this configuration bootstrap.

ConfigurationProfiles.description: Lists the configuration profiles associated with this configuration bootstrap.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this configuration profile.

ConfigurationScopes.description: Lists the configuration scopes associated with this configuration profile.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this configuration scope.

Type.description: Type discriminator for this configuration scope.

Resolver.description: Specifies the resolver for this configuration scope.

PolicyAuthority.description: Indicates whether policy authority applies to this configuration scope.

Mandatory.description: Indicates whether mandatory applies to this configuration scope.

ConfigurationProviders.description: Lists the configuration providers associated with this configuration scope.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this configuration provider.

Priority.description: Specifies the priority for this configuration provider.

Name.description: Human-readable name of this configuration scope.

Description.description: Human-readable description of this configuration scope.

Name.description: Human-readable name of this configuration profile.

Description.description: Human-readable description of this configuration profile.

ConfigurationProviders.description: Lists the configuration providers associated with this configuration bootstrap.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this configuration provider.

Type.description: Type discriminator for this configuration provider.

Settings.description: Structured settings associated with this configuration provider.

AuthenticationProfileId.description: Stable identifier of the authentication profile associated with this configuration provider.

Name.description: Human-readable name of this configuration provider.

Description.description: Human-readable description of this configuration provider.

ConfigurationScopeResolvers.description: Lists the configuration scope resolvers associated with this configuration bootstrap.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this configuration scope resolver.

Type.description: Type discriminator for this configuration scope resolver.

Settings.description: Structured settings associated with this configuration scope resolver.

Name.description: Human-readable name of this configuration scope resolver.

Description.description: Human-readable description of this configuration scope resolver.

Metadata.description: Additional structured metadata associated with this configuration bootstrap.

ConfigurationProfileSources.description: Lists the configuration profile sources associated with this configuration bootstrap.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this configuration profile source.

Uri.description: URI or URL identifying the uri associated with this configuration profile source.

AuthenticationProfileId.description: Stable identifier of the authentication profile associated with this configuration profile source.

Required.description: Indicates whether required applies to this configuration profile source.

Name.description: Human-readable name of this configuration profile source.

Description.description: Human-readable description of this configuration profile source.

ResourceKey.description: Optional localization resource key for the human-readable text.

displayText.description: Defines the reusable display text structure used by this canonical schema.
